\begin{align*}\frac{\cos \theta}{\mu_0 c} E_0(Rcos\left[\frac{\omega}{c}(x \sin \theta) - \omega t + \phi\right] - \cos\left[\frac{\omega}{c}(x \sin \theta) - \omega t\right]) \\= - \cos \gamma \frac{\sqrt{\omega \mu_0 \sigma} E_s}{\omega} e^{-\sqrt{\omega \mu_0 \sigma} / 2(x \sin \gamma)} \cos\left[\sqrt{\omega \mu_0 \sigma / 2}(x \sin \gamma) + \frac{\pi}{4} - \omega t + \varphi\right] \#(8)(2).\end{align*}
$$

其中 $(7)(8)$ 式需要下列对应方法进行求解，注意到这是在一个具体的位置考察关系，因此选择 $x = 0$ 建立关系即可。此外考虑到相位的连续性，必须要求:

$$
\sqrt{\omega \mu_{0} \sigma / 2} \sin \gamma = \frac{\omega}{c} \sin \theta \#(9)
$$

接下来展开方程组:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\cos \theta}{\mu_{0} c}(R \cos \left[-\omega t+\phi\right]-\cos \left[-\omega t\right])=&-\cos \gamma \frac{\sqrt{\omega \mu_{0} \sigma} E_{s}}{\omega E_{0}} \cos \left[\frac{\pi}{4}-\omega t+\varphi\right] \#(10)(2) \\\cos \left[-\omega t\right]+R \cos \left[-\omega t+\phi\right]=&\frac{E_{s}}{E_{0}} \cos \left[-\omega t+\varphi\right] \#(11)(2)\end{aligned}
$$

为了时间上也是对应的，展开，确保正弦和余弦部分都是对应的:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\cos \theta}{\mu_{0} c}(R \cos \phi - 1) = & - \cos \gamma \frac{\sqrt{\omega \mu_{0} \sigma} E_{s}}{\omega E_{0}} \cos \left( \frac{\pi}{4} + \varphi \right) \#(12)(1) \\\frac{\cos \theta}{\mu_{0} c} R \sin \phi = & - \cos \gamma \frac{\sqrt{\omega \mu_{0} \sigma} E_{s}}{\omega E_{0}} \sin \left( \frac{\pi}{4} + \varphi \right) \#(13)(1) \\R \cos \phi + 1 = & \frac{E_{s}}{E_{0}} \cos \varphi \#(14)(1) \\R \sin \phi = & \frac{E_{s}}{E_{0}} \sin \varphi \#(15)(1)\end{aligned}
$$

③利用了复数表示后，上面的时间方程可以写成:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\cos \theta}{\mu_{0} c} \big( R e^{i(-\omega t+\phi)} - e^{i(-\omega t)} \big) = & - \cos \gamma \frac{\sqrt{\omega \mu_{0} \sigma} E_{s}}{\omega E_{0}} e^{i \left( \frac{\pi}{4} - \omega t + \varphi \right)} \#(16) \\R e^{i(-\omega t+\varphi)} + e^{i(-\omega t)} = & \frac{E_{s}}{E_{0}} e^{i(-\omega t + \varphi)} \#(17)\end{aligned}
$$

显而易见可以存在关系:

$$
\bar{r} + 1 = \frac{E_s}{E_0} e^{i \varphi}, \bar{r} - 1 = - \frac{\mu_0 c \sqrt{\omega \mu_0} \sigma \cos \gamma}{\omega \cos \theta} \frac{E_s}{E_0} e^{i \left( \frac{\pi}{4} + \varphi \right)} \#(18)(2)
$$

接下来消去振幅比:

$$
\tilde{r} - 1 = - \frac{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{\omega\mu_{0}\sigma/2}\cos\gamma}{\omega\cos\theta}(1 + i)(\tilde{r} + 1)\#(19)
$$

得到:

$$
\tilde { r } = \frac { 1 - \frac { \mu _ { 0 } c \sqrt { \omega \mu _ { 0 } \sigma / 2 } \cos \gamma } { \omega \cos \theta } ( 1 + i ) } { 1 + \frac { \mu _ { 0 } c \sqrt { \omega \mu _ { 0 } \sigma / 2 } \cos \gamma } { \omega \cos \theta } ( 1 + i ) } \# ( 2 0 ) ( 3 )
$$

(2)从上面的计算结果可以发现耗散应该以cosθ形式出现，而给定长度l的传播反射次数为 $N = l / (2D \tan \theta)$此时两种效应结合:

$$
r \sim \cos \theta \times \frac{l}{2D \tan \theta} \sim \frac{\cos^2 \theta}{\sin \theta} \neq (21)(1)
$$

这个直觉上的断言说明θ越大越好——（2分);

(3)如果希望出现干涉，那么必须要确保任何一束光都存在和其角度相同，且比它滞后横向距离:

$$
\Delta x = 2D\tan \theta \ne (22)(1)
$$

以上的光线存在，然而对于题给的情形，不难看出注入光两侧边缘的最大距离为:

$$
s = D \tan \theta < \Delta x \#(23)(1)
$$

因此不存在几何光学许可的干涉——(2分);

(4)此时末态强度不过是初态强度乘上反射率的N次方，因为没有干涉效应。此时先利用(20)计算强度反射率，考虑到强导电近似 $\sigma \mu _ { 0 } \gg \omega / c ^ { 2 }$

$$
\begin{aligned}\bar{r} = & \frac{1 - \frac{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{\omega\mu_{0}\sigma/2}cos\gamma}{\omega cos\theta}(1 + i)}{1 + \frac{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{\omega\mu_{0}\sigma/2}cos\gamma}{\omega cos\theta}(1 + i)} = \frac{- \frac{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{\omega\mu_{0}\sigma/2}cos\gamma}{\omega cos\theta}(1 + i)}{\omega cos\theta}(1 + i) \left[1 - \frac{1}{\frac{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{\omega\mu_{0}\sigma/2}cos\gamma}{\omega cos\theta}(1 + i)}\right] \\& \quad - \frac{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{\omega\mu_{0}\sigma/2}cos\gamma}{\omega cos\theta}(1 + i) \left[1 + \frac{1}{\frac{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{\omega\mu_{0}\sigma/2}cos\gamma}{\omega cos\theta}(1 + i)}\right] \\\approx & - \left(1 - \frac{2\omega cos\theta(1 - i)}{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{2\omega\mu_{0}\sigma}cos\gamma}\right)\#(24)(2)\end{aligned}
$$

这一项给出:

$$
R = | \vec{r} |^2 = \left( 1 - \frac{2 \omega \cos \theta}{\mu_0 c \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_0 \sigma} \cos \gamma} \right)^2 + \left( \frac{2 \omega \cos \theta}{\mu_0 c \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_0 \sigma} \cos \gamma} \right)^2 \approx 1 - \frac{4 \omega \cos \theta}{\mu_0 c \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_0 \sigma} \cos \gamma} \#(25)(2)
$$

最后考虑到:

$$
\sqrt{\omega\mu_{0}\sigma/2}\sin\gamma=\frac{\omega}{c}\sin\theta\rightarrow\gamma\rightarrow0\#(26)
$$

得到:

$$
R \approx 1 - \frac{4\omega\cos\theta}{\mu_{0}c\sqrt{2\omega\mu_{0}\sigma}} \#(27)(1)
$$

而传播的反射次数:

$$
N = \frac{L}{2D \tan \theta} \#(28)
$$

得到:

$$
\frac{E_{out}}{E_{min}}=\sqrt{R}\approx\left(1-\frac{2\omega\cos\theta}{\mu_0c\sqrt{2\omega\mu_0\sigma}}\right)^{\frac{L}{2D\tan\theta}}
$$

【本小问不作要求】考虑到N很大，可以利用对数计算上述的指数结果:

$$
e^{\frac{L}{2D\tan\theta}ln\left(1-\frac{2\omega\cos\theta}{\mu_0c\sqrt{2\omega\mu_0\sigma}}\right)} \approx exp\left[-\frac{L\omega\cos\theta}{\mu_0cD\tan\theta\sqrt{2\omega\mu_0\sigma}}\right]\#(29)
$$

(5)此时考虑给定的出口和给定的“激发波”的入射点x，此时该入射点只需要:

代入轴向

$$
N = \frac{L - x}{2D\tan\theta} \#(30)
$$

次反射即可抵达终点，对于给定位置，有:

$$
N^{'} = \frac{L}{2D \tan \theta} \#(31)
$$

个位点贡献辐射光，自起点到接收端依次标记这N个位置，可以得到第i个入射点的贡献，以复振幅表示:

$$
\hat { E } _ { o u t } = \hat { E } _ { 0 } e ^ { - \alpha x } \hat { r } ^ { N } e ^ { i \Delta \varphi } \# ( 3 2 ) ( 2 )
$$

其中相位则是相对观测点而言，光线传播诱发的相位，它为:

$$
\Delta \varphi = N \times k \times \left( \frac{2D}{\cos \theta} - 2D \tan \theta \sin \theta \right) = 2DN \frac{\omega}{c} \cos \theta \#(33)(3)
$$

其中 $k = \omega / c$ 是光波波矢，而括号第一个项是几何光程，第二个项是波前的贡献:

$$
E _ { o u t } = E _ { 0 } e ^ { - 2 D \alpha \tan \theta ( N - N ) / \lambda } \Big ( \bar { r } e ^ { 2 i D \bar { \xi } \cos \theta } \Big ) ^ { N } = E _ { 0 } e ^ { - 2 D \alpha \tan \theta N / \lambda } \Big ( \bar { r } e ^ { 2 i D \bar { \xi } \cos \theta } e ^ { 2 D \alpha \tan \theta / \lambda } \Big ) ^ { N } \# ( 3 4 ) ( 2 )
$$

最后关于所有位点叠加:

$$
E_{\mathrm{out,total}} = E_{0}e^{-2D\alpha\tan\theta/\lambda} \sum_{N=0}^{N} \left( \bar{r}e^{2D\bar{r}_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}\cos\theta}e^{2D\alpha\tan\theta/\lambda} \right)^{N} = E_{0}e^{-2D\alpha\tan\theta/\lambda} \frac{1 - \left( \bar{r}e^{2D\bar{r}_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}\cos\theta}e^{2D\alpha\tan\theta/\lambda} \right)^{N}}{1 - \bar{r}e^{2D\bar{r}_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}\cos\theta}e^{2D\alpha\tan\theta/\lambda}} \#(35)(3)
$$

因此木态对应:

$$
\left| \frac{E_{out,total}}{E_0} \right| = e^{-2D\alpha \tan \theta N / \lambda} \left| \frac{1 - \left( \tilde{r} e^{2iD_c^{\omega} \cos \theta} e^{2D\alpha \tan \theta / \lambda} \right)^N}{1 - \tilde{r} e^{2iD_c^{\omega} \cos \theta} e^{2D\alpha \tan \theta / \lambda}} \right| \neq (36)(1)
$$

(6)其中考察(36)的分母，如果分母极小，即:

$$
2D\frac{\omega}{c}\cos\theta = 2\pi \cdot m\#(37)\tag{2)当电子}
$$

显然极小，因为反射率的相位几乎为零。此时得到最佳模式:

$$
\cos \theta = \frac{\pi c}{\omega D} \cdot m \neq (38)(3)
$$

(7)几何光学近似下:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{E_{out}}{E_{min}} = \sqrt{R}^N \approx \left(1 - \frac{2\omega\cos\theta}{\mu_0 c \sqrt{2\omega\mu_0 \sigma}}\right)^{\frac{L}{2D\tan\theta}} = exp\left[-\frac{L\omega\cos\theta}{\mu_0 c D\tan\theta \sqrt{2\omega\mu_0 \sigma}}\right] \\\Longrightarrow \frac{I_{out}}{I_{in}} = exp\left[-\frac{2L\omega\cos^2\theta}{\mu_0 c D\sin\theta \sqrt{2\omega\mu_0 \sigma}}\right] \#(39)\end{aligned}
$$

代入模式条件:

$$
\frac{I_{out}}{I_{in}}=exp\left[-\frac{2L\omega\left(\frac{\pi c}{\omega D}\cdot m\right)^{2}}{\mu_{0}cD\sqrt{2\omega\mu_{0}\sigma}\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{\pi c}{\omega D}\cdot m\right)^{2}}}\right]\#(40)\tag{这里代}
$$

这里发

对于4信号传输:

$$
\cos \theta_{4} = \frac{4 \pi c}{\omega D} = \frac{2 \lambda}{D} < 1, \bar{\lambda} < \frac{D}{2} \#(41)(2)
$$

对于信号衰减要求，考虑到:

$$
\Delta \left[ \frac{2L\omega \left( \frac{\pi c}{\omega D} \cdot m \right)^2}{\mu_0 c D \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_0 \sigma} \sqrt{1 - \left( \frac{\pi c}{\omega D} \cdot m \right)^2}} \right] < - \ln 0.9 \#(42)\tag{这里自}
$$

自然得到:

利用z

$$
\Delta \frac{\left( \frac{\pi c}{\omega D} \cdot m \right)^{2}}{\sqrt{1 - \left( \frac{\pi c}{\omega D} \cdot m \right)^{2}}} = \frac{\left( \frac{2\lambda}{D} \right)^{2}}{\sqrt{1 - \left( \frac{2\lambda}{D} \right)^{2}}} - 1 < \frac{\mu_{0}cD\sqrt{2\omega\mu_{0}\sigma}}{2L\omega}ln\frac{10}{9}\#(43)(2)\tag{3)研}
$$

这个更强的条件要求:

$$
\begin{aligned}x = \left( \frac{2\lambda}{D} \right)^{2}, x^{2} < \left( 1 + \frac{\mu_{\theta} c D \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_{\theta} \sigma}}{2 L \omega} l n \frac{10}{9} \right)^{2} (1 - z), \\x < - \frac{1}{2} \left( 1 + \frac{\mu_{\theta} c D \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_{\theta} \sigma}}{2 L \omega} l n \frac{10}{9} \right)^{2} + \sqrt{\frac{1}{4} \left( 1 + \frac{\mu_{\theta} c D \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_{\theta} \sigma}}{2 L \omega} l n \frac{10}{9} \right)^{2} + \left( 1 + \frac{\mu_{\theta} c D \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_{\theta} \sigma}}{2 L \omega} l n \frac{10}{9} \right)^{2}} \#(44) \\\lambda < \frac{D}{2} \sqrt{- \frac{1}{2} \left( 1 + \frac{\mu_{\theta} c D \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_{\theta} \sigma}}{2 L \omega} l n \frac{10}{9} \right)^{2} + \sqrt{\frac{1}{4} \left( 1 + \frac{\mu_{\theta} c D \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_{\theta} \sigma}}{2 L \omega} l n \frac{10}{9} \right)^{2} + \left( 1 + \frac{\mu_{\theta} c D \sqrt{2 \omega \mu_{\theta} \sigma}}{2 L \omega} l n \frac{10}{9} \right)^{2}}} \#(45)(2)\end{aligned}
$$

三、（60分）参考解答:

(1)沿着z轴选取一个横向长度为 $z \sim z + dz$ ，横截半径为r的柱体，此时通过该柱体的磁通量为零，此时z方向和径向面贡献之和为:

$$\pi r ^ { 2 } B _ { z } ( z + d z ) - \pi r ^ { 2 } B _ { z } ( z ) + 2 \pi r \times d z \times B _ { r } = 0 \# ( 1 ) ( 2 )$$

利用泰勒展开得到:

$$\pi r^{2}\frac{dB_{z}}{dz}+2\pi rB_{r}=0\#(2)$$

代入轴向磁场公式给出:

$$B _ { r } ( r , z ) = - \frac { r } { 2 } \frac { d B _ { z } } { d z } = B _ { 0 } \beta r z e ^ { - \beta z ^ { 2 } } \neq ( 3 ) ( 2 )$$

(2)当电子在磁场中运动时，会受到洛伦兹力作用，此时动力学方程的矢量形式为:

$$m_{e}\frac{d^{2}\vec{r}}{dt^{2}}=-e\vec{v}\times\vec{B}=-e\begin{vmatrix}\hat{r}&\hat{\theta}&\hat{z}\\\hat{r}&r\hat{\theta}&\hat{z}\\B_{r}&0&B_{z}\end{vmatrix}\neq(4)(1)$$

代入柱坐标的加速度公式，自然得到下列分量方程:

$$\begin{array} { c } { { m _ { c } \ddot { z } = e B _ { r } r \dot { \theta } \# ( 5 ) } } \\ { { m _ { e } ( \ddot { r } - r \dot { \theta } ^ { 2 } ) = -   e r B _ { z } \dot { \theta } \# ( 6 ) ( 1 ) } } \\ { { m _ { e } ( r \ddot { \theta } + 2 \dot { r } \dot { \theta } ) = -   e ( B _ { r } \dot { z } - B _ { z } \dot { r } ) \# ( 7 ) ( 1 ) } } \end{array}$$

由于电子有着沿z方向的高速度，因此没必要考虑z方向动力学方程，为了计算角速度，先考察切向方程，研究角动量形式:

$$r \times m_{e}(r\ddot{\theta} + 2r\dot{\theta}) = -r \times e(B_{r}\dot{z} - B_{z}\dot{r}) \Longrightarrow m_{e}(r^{2}\ddot{\theta} + 2r\dot{\theta}) = -e\left(-\frac{r^{2}}{2}\frac{dB_{z}}{dz}\dot{z} - B_{z}\dot{r}\dot{r}\right)\dot{\theta}(8)$$

这里代入了(3)式，利用微分恒等式可以得到:

$$m _ { e } ( r ^ { 2 } \ddot { \theta } + 2 r \dot { r } \dot { \theta } ) = m _ { e } \frac { d } { d t } ( r ^ { 2 } \dot { \theta } ) ; e \left( - \frac { r ^ { 2 } } { 2 } \frac { d B _ { z } } { d z } \dot { z } - B _ { z } r \dot { r } \right) = - \frac { 1 } { 2 } e \frac { d } { d t } ( B _ { z } r ^ { 2 } ) \dot { \theta } ( 9 ) ( 2 )$$

这里发现存在守恒量:

$$\frac { d } { d t } \left[ m _ { e } r ^ { 2 } \dot { \theta } - \frac { 1 } { 2 } e B _ { z } r ^ { 2 } \right] = 0 \# ( 1 0 )$$

注意到入射的位置 $u \gg 1 / \sqrt { \beta } ,$ 所以入射位置的初始 $B_{z}$ 磁场可忽略，结合在轴线上的入射点的出射电子并不具有相对轴线的角速度:

$$m _ { e } r ^ { 2 } \dot { \theta } - \frac { 1 } { 2 } e B _ { z } r ^ { 2 } = m _ { e } r ^ { 2 } \left( \dot { \theta } - \frac { e B _ { z } } { 2 m _ { e } } \right) = 0 \neq ( 1 1 )$$

这里自然给出 $\mathsf { T }$

$$\dot{\theta} = \frac{e B_z}{2 m_e} \#(12)$$

利用 $z = 0 , B _ { z } = B _ { 0 }$ 的事实:

$$\omega_{0}=\dot{\theta}=\frac{eB_{0}}{2m_{e}}\#(13)(2)$$

(3)研究系统的径向动力学方程:

$$m_{e}(\bar{r}-r\dot{\theta}^{2})=-erB_{e}\dot{\theta}\Longrightarrow\bar{r}=r\dot{\theta}^{2}-\frac{eB_{e}\dot{\theta}}{m_{e}}=\left(\frac{eB_{e}}{2m_{e}}\right)^{2}r-2\left(\frac{eB_{e}}{2m_{e}}\right)^{2}r=-\frac{e^{2}B_{e}^{2}}{4m_{e}^{2}}r\dot{\theta}(14)(2)$$

作为微扰，可以近似认为此过程中r的变化很小，但是会受到一个冲击作用，此时在零级近似下:

$$I = \Delta p_{r} \approx - m_{e} l \frac{e^{2}}{4 m_{e}^{2}} \int B_{z}^{2} dt \neq (15)$$

注意到轴向运动速度近乎为零:

$$d t \approx \frac{d z}{v_{0}} \#(16)(1)$$

此时可以求出:

$$l \approx - m _ { e } l \frac { e ^ { 2 } } { 4 m _ { e } ^ { 2 } v _ { 0 } } \int B _ { z } ^ { 2 } d z \# ( 1 7 ) ( 2 )$$

考虑到入射出射的尺度远大于 $1 / { \sqrt { \beta } } ,$ 积分可以延展至无穷远:

$$I \approx - m _ { e } l \frac { e ^ { 2 } } { 4 m _ { e } ^ { 2 } v _ { 0 } } \int _ { - \infty } ^ { \infty } B _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } e ^ { - 2 \beta z ^ { 2 } } d z = - m _ { e } l \frac { e ^ { 2 } B _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 4 m _ { e } ^ { 2 } v _ { 0 } } \sqrt { \frac { \pi } { 2 \beta } } \# ( 1 8 ) ( 2 )$$

(4)对于给定的入射半径l，此时初始径向速度为:

$$v_{r}=v_{0}\times \frac{l}{u}\#(19)(1)$$

进而可以给出末态速度:

$$v _ { r } ^ { \dot { } } = v _ { r } - l \frac { e ^ { 2 } B _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 4 m _ { e } ^ { 2 } v _ { 0 } } \sqrt { \frac { \pi } { 2 \beta } } = l \left[ \frac { v _ { 0 } } { u } - \frac { e ^ { 2 } B _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 4 m _ { e } ^ { 2 } v _ { 0 } } \sqrt { \frac { \pi } { 2 \beta } } \right] \neq ( 2 0 ) ( 2 )$$

注意到末态位置v和末态径向速度满足几何关系:

$$\frac{l}{w} \approx - \frac{v_{r}^{'}}{v_{0}} \#(21)(1)$$

这里注意到了轴向速度几乎不变的事实。此时可以得到:

$$\frac{l}{w} \approx - l \left[ \frac{1}{u} - \frac{e^2 B_0^2}{4 m_c^2 v_0^2} \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2 \beta}} \right] \#(22)$$

可以发现 $_ { i } v$ 与具体的l无关，满足类似于透镜成像的公式:

$$\frac{1}{u} + \frac{1}{w} = \frac{e^{2}B_{0}^{2}}{4m_{e}^{2}v_{0}^{2}}\sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2\beta}} \Longrightarrow w = \frac{u}{\frac{e^{2}B_{0}^{2}}{4m_{e}^{2}v_{0}^{2}}\sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2\beta}}u - 1}\#(23)(2).$$

(5)①由于热扰动能量的换算电压为:

$$V \sim \frac{k_{B}T}{c} = 8.63 \times 10^{-5}T(V) \neq (24)$$

对于室温T\~300K，热扰动的有效电压为:

$$V \sim 0.026V \#(25)$$

四、（45分）参考解答:

(1)①根据基尔霍夫热辐射定律，发射特性和吸收特性必须一致——（2分)，所以:

![](data/images/2023-1066547c/2023-培尖-暑假-第二套-答案-培尖第二期-1.jpg)

——（4分）

②首先注意到经过薄膜处理的辐射本质上是薄膜的辐射谱。因此若工作温度发生改变，导致对应温度的黑体辐射谱变化，那么即便发射率保持不变，辐射峰也会发生改变，不再确保绝大多数波段都位于对应区间。如果工作温度下降至T，根据维恩位移定律可以估算主要波段从 $\lambda_{0}=(370+1100)/2=735nm$ 偏移后的峰:

$$
\lambda = \frac{T_{0}}{T} \lambda_{0} \tag{1}
$$

为了确保输出不会下降至一半，那么峰不能偏移至1100nm附近:

$$
\lambda^{'} < 1100 \Longrightarrow T^{'} < \frac{2}{3}T_{0} \tag{2}
$$

从太阳辐射谱不难看出370～1100nm波段覆盖了对应温度黑体辐射的绝大多数谱部分，可以近似按照黑体辐射估算辐射功率:

$$
P \approx P_{0}\left(\frac{T}{T_{0}}\right)^{4} < \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{4}P_{0}\tag{3}
$$

$$

$$

因此切割份数为M时，得到:

节约比为:

$$
\sum V / V_{0} = 1 / N \tag{21}
$$

$$
\eta = 1 - \frac{1}{N} \tag{22}
$$

五、（50分）参考解答:

(1)在τ质心系中系统动量为零，反应粒子的动量大小相同:

$$p_{\nu}c = \frac{m_{\bar{\pi}}\beta_{\bar{\pi}}c}{\sqrt{1 - \beta_{\bar{\pi}}^2}}\#(1)(2)$$

考虑到能量相同:

$$m_{r}c^{2}=\frac{m_{\pi}c^{2}}{\sqrt{1-\beta_{\pi}^{2}}}+p_{\nu}c\#(2)$$

联立求解消去 $\mathfrak{p}_{\nu}$ 得到 $\beta_{\pi}$ 的方程:

$$m_{\tau} = m_{\pi} \frac{1 + \beta_{\pi}}{\sqrt{1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2}}} = m_{\pi} \sqrt{\frac{1 + \beta_{\pi}}{1 - \beta_{\pi}}}\#(3)$$

化简得到:

$$v_{\pi} = \beta_{\pi} c = \frac{m_{\tau}^{2} - m_{\pi}^{2}}{m_{\tau}^{2} + m_{\pi}^{2}} c \#(4)(2)$$

(2)取τ粒子的运动方向为z方向。由于洛伦兹变换不会改变速度轴上的朝向，此时本征系也可以沿用该z轴的说法。按照要求，可以写出速度:

$$\vec{v}_{\pi^{\pm}} = \beta_{\pi} c \big(\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\phi^{\pm}, \sin\theta^{\pm}\sin\phi^{\pm}, \cos\theta^{\pm}\big)\#(5)(1)$$

由于两个τ粒子在某一点通过正负电子湮灭后将会开始运动，而且粒子的最大间距为:

$$d = 2 \beta_{\tau} c \tau_{0}\#(7)(2)$$

给定速度方向后，引入标量长度参数 $s_{\pm}$，可以得到地面系中两条迹线任意两点的间距:

$$\vec{l} = \vec{a} + \vec{v}_{\pi^{+}}s_{+} + \vec{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{-} \Longrightarrow l^2 = d^2 + s_{+}^2 + s_{-}^2 + 2\vec{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \vec{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{+}s_{-} + 2\vec{a} \cdot \vec{v}_{\pi^{+}}s_{+} + 2\vec{a} \cdot \vec{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{-} \#(8)(2)$$

虽然是矢量加法，但是只要让s为负数即可替代减法。为了求它的极值，这里要求:

$$\partial_{s_{+}}l^{2}=\partial_{s_{-}}l^{2}=0 \Longrightarrow 2s_{+}+2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{-}+2\vec{d}\cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}=0; 2s_{-}+2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{+}+2\vec{d}\cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}=0 \#(9)(3)$$

这里可以求解得到:

$$\begin{aligned}s_{-} = & \frac{\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} - \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}}{1 - \left( \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \right)^{2}} \#(10)(2) \\ s_{+} = & \frac{\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} - \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}}{1 - \left( \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \right)^{2}} \#(11)(2)\end{aligned}$$

得到:

$$l = \sqrt{d^{2} + \frac{2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} - \left( \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \right)^{2} - \left( \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \right)^{2}}{1 - \left( \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \right)^{2}}}$$

(3)注意到无论是否是相对论，考虑到速度的反对称，参考系变换后的速度同样还是反对称的，此时可以进一步化简结果。不过此处会出现发散问题，为了解决问题，考虑先让 $\vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} = -\vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}$，$\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \neq 1$

$$\begin{aligned}d^{2}+\frac{2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\cdot\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}-\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}-\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\right)^{2}}{1-\left(\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\right)^{2}}=d^{2}+\frac{2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\cdot\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}-2\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}}{1-\left(\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\right)^{2}}\\=d^{2}-\frac{2}{1+\left|\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\right|}\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}\rightarrow d^{2}-\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}\#(14)(3)\end{aligned}$$

因此平均结果只要计算后者的平均值即可。由于本题考虑的是非相对论极限:利用相对论速度合成公式:

$$v_{\perp} = \frac{u_{y} \sqrt{1 - v_{c}^{2} / c^{2}}}{1 + \frac{v_{c} u_{x}}{c^{2}}} \approx u_{y} - \frac{u_{x} u_{y}}{c^{2}} v_{c} \#(15)$$

$$v_{//} = \frac{u_{r} + v_{c}}{1 + \frac{v_{c} u_{r}}{c^{2}}} \approx u_{r} + v_{c}\left[1 - \left(\frac{u_{r}}{c}\right)^{2}\right] \#(16)$$

$$\vec{v}_{\pi^{\pm}}^{\prime} = \pm \left( \begin{matrix} \beta_{\pi} c \sin\theta^{\pm} \cos\phi^{\pm} - \beta_{\pi}^{2} \sin\theta^{\pm} \cos\theta^{\pm} \beta_{\tau} c \cos\phi^{\pm} \\ \beta_{\pi} c \sin\theta^{\pm} \sin\phi^{\pm} - \beta_{\pi}^{2} \cos\theta^{\pm} \sin\theta^{\pm} \beta_{\tau} c \sin\phi^{\pm} \\ \beta_{\pi} c \cos\theta^{\pm} + \beta_{\pi}^{2} \beta_{\tau} c \sin^{2}\theta^{\pm} \end{matrix} \right) \#(17)(3)$$

因此可以得到:

$$\begin{aligned}\hat{v}_{\pi^{\pm}}^{\prime} \approx & \pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{\beta_{\pi}^{2}+2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}^{3}\cos\theta^{\pm}\sin^{2}\theta^{\pm}\left(1-\cos^{2}\phi-\sin^{2}\phi\right)}}\left(\begin{aligned}&\beta_{\pi}\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\phi^{\pm}-\beta_{\pi}^{2}\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\theta^{\pm}\beta_{\tau}\cos\phi^{\pm}\\&\beta_{\pi}\sin\theta^{\pm}\sin\phi^{\pm}-\beta_{\pi}^{2}\cos\theta^{\pm}\sin\theta^{\pm}\beta_{\tau}\sin\phi^{\pm}\\&\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta^{\pm}+\beta_{\pi}^{2}\beta_{\tau}\sin^{2}\theta^{\pm}\end{aligned}\right) \\=&\pm\left(\begin{aligned}&\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\phi^{\pm}-\beta_{\pi}\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\theta^{\pm}\beta_{\tau}\cos\phi^{\pm}\\&\sin\theta^{\pm}\sin\phi^{\pm}-\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta^{\pm}\sin\theta^{\pm}\beta_{\tau}\sin\phi^{\pm}\\&\cos\theta^{\pm}+\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\sin^{2}\theta^{\pm}\end{aligned}\right)\#(18)(2)\end{aligned}$$

此时对应:

$$\vec{d} \cdot \vec{v}_{\pi^{\pm}}^{\prime} \approx \pm d (\cos\theta^{\pm} + \beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\sin^{2}\theta^{\pm}) \#(19)(1)$$

从这里不难看出是否考虑变换的必要性并不大，末态速度仍然是本底速度的结果:

$$\overline{d^{2}}=d^{2}-\frac{d^{2}}{4\pi}\int\cos^{2}\theta\times2\pi\sin\theta d\theta=\frac{2}{3}d^{2}\#(20)(4)$$

即:

$$\sqrt{\overline{d_{min}^{2}}}=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{3}d=\frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3}\beta_{\tau}c\tau_{0}\#(21)(1)$$

(4)对于相对论情况，这里先计算变换后的速度，以π+为例:

$$\left( \sin\theta^{+}\cos\phi^{+}, \sin\theta^{+}\sin\phi^{+}, \cos\theta^{+} \right)$$

$$\frac{1}{1 + \beta_{\tau}\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta}\left( \sqrt{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}\beta_{\pi}c\sin\theta^{+}\cos\phi^{+},\sqrt{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}\beta_{\pi}c\sin\theta^{+}\sin\phi^{+},\beta_{\pi}c\cos\theta^{+} + \beta_{\tau}c \right) \#(22)$$

此时其大小可以计算矢量部分的模值给出:

$$c^{2}[(\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta^{+}+\beta_{\tau})^{2}+(1-\beta_{\tau}^{2})(\beta_{\pi}\sin\theta^{+})^{2}]=c^{2}[\beta_{\pi}^{2}+\beta_{\tau}^{2}+2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\cos\theta^{+}-\beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}\sin^{2}\theta^{+}]\#(23)(1)$$

因此得到末态速度公式:

$$\hat{v}_{z} = \frac{\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta^{+} + \beta_{\tau}}{\sqrt{\beta_{\pi}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} + 2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\cos\theta^{+} - \beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}\sin^{2}\theta^{+}}} \#(24)$$

此时其平方平均为:

$$\begin{aligned}\overline{v_{z}^{2}} = & \frac{1}{4\pi} \int \frac{\left( \beta_{\pi} \cos\theta + \beta_{\tau} \right)^{2}}{\beta_{\pi}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} + 2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\cos\theta + \beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}\sin^{2}\theta} 2\pi \sin\theta d\theta \\= & \frac{1}{2} \int \frac{\left( \beta_{\pi} x + \beta_{\tau} \right)^{2} dx}{- \frac{1}{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}x^{2} + 2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}x - \beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}} \#(25)(2)\end{aligned}$$

这个结果非常难计算，为了方便起见，将表达式写作:

定义:

$$\frac{\left( \beta_{\pi} x + \beta_{\tau} \right)^{2}}{\beta_{\pi}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} \beta_{\pi}^{2} x^{2} + 2 \beta_{\pi} \beta_{\tau} x - \beta_{\tau}^{2} \beta_{\pi}^{2}} = \frac{\left( \beta_{\pi} x + \beta_{\tau} \right)^{2}}{- \left( 1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2} \right)\left( 1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2} \right) + \left( \beta_{\pi} \beta_{\tau} x + 1 \right)^{2}}$$

$$\begin{aligned}\xi = \frac{\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}x + 1}{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \Longrightarrow \frac{1}{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}\left( \frac{\beta_{\tau} + \left[ \sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}\xi - 1 \right] / \beta_{\pi}}{\xi^{2} - 1} \right)^{2} \\\Longrightarrow \frac{\left( \xi - \frac{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}{\beta_{\tau}\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \right)^{2}}{\beta_{\tau}^{2}(\xi^{2} - 1)} \#(27)\end{aligned}$$

积分的上下限对应 $\frac{\pm \beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}+1}{\sqrt{(1-\beta_{\pi}^{2})(1-\beta_{\tau}^{2})}}$ 而且积分对应:

$$I = \frac{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}{2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}^{3}}\int\frac{\frac{\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau} + 1}{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}\left( \xi - \frac{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}{\beta_{\tau}\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \right)^{2}}{\frac{- \beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau} + 1}{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}\left( \xi^{2} - 1 \right)}d\xi\#(28)$$

这里利用:

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{\xi^{2}-2\alpha\xi+\alpha^{2}}{\xi^{2}-1}=1+\frac{\alpha^{2}+1-2\alpha\xi}{\xi^{2}-1}=1+\frac{\alpha^{2}+1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{\xi-1}-\frac{1}{\xi+1}\right)-\alpha\left(\frac{1}{\xi-1}+\frac{1}{\xi+1}\right) \\=1+\frac{(\alpha-1)^{2}}{2}\frac{1}{\xi-1}-\frac{(\alpha+1)^{2}}{2}\frac{1}{\xi+1}\end{aligned}$$

因此积分结果为:

$$\begin{aligned}I = & \frac{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}{2\beta_{\tau}\beta_{\tau}^{2}} \left[ \begin{aligned} & \frac{2\beta_{\tau}\beta_{\tau}}{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \\ + & \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}{\beta_{\tau}\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} - 1\right)^{2}\ln\frac{\beta_{\tau}\beta_{\tau} + 1 - \sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}{-\beta_{\tau}\beta_{\tau} + 1 - \sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \end{aligned}\right] \#(30)(3) \end{aligned}$$

此时最短距离为:

$$\sqrt{\overline{d_{min}^2}} = d\sqrt{1 - I} \#(31)$$
questions.analysis:
(1)在τ质心系中系统动量为零，反应粒子的动量大小相同:

$$p_{\nu}c = \frac{m_{\bar{\pi}}\beta_{\bar{\pi}}c}{\sqrt{1 - \beta_{\bar{\pi}}^2}}\#(1)(2)$$

考虑到能量相同:

$$m_{r}c^{2}=\frac{m_{\pi}c^{2}}{\sqrt{1-\beta_{\pi}^{2}}}+p_{\nu}c\#(2)$$

联立求解消去 $\mathfrak{p}_{\nu}$ 得到 $\beta_{\pi}$ 的方程:

$$m_{\tau} = m_{\pi} \frac{1 + \beta_{\pi}}{\sqrt{1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2}}} = m_{\pi} \sqrt{\frac{1 + \beta_{\pi}}{1 - \beta_{\pi}}}\#(3)$$

化简得到:

$$v_{\pi} = \beta_{\pi} c = \frac{m_{\tau}^{2} - m_{\pi}^{2}}{m_{\tau}^{2} + m_{\pi}^{2}} c \#(4)(2)$$

(2)取τ粒子的运动方向为z方向。由于洛伦兹变换不会改变速度轴上的朝向，此时本征系也可以沿用该z轴的说法。按照要求，可以写出速度:

$$\vec{v}_{\pi^{\pm}} = \beta_{\pi} c \big(\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\phi^{\pm}, \sin\theta^{\pm}\sin\phi^{\pm}, \cos\theta^{\pm}\big)\#(5)(1)$$

由于两个τ粒子在某一点通过正负电子湮灭后将会开始运动，而且粒子的最大间距为:

$$d = 2 \beta_{\tau} c \tau_{0}\#(7)(2)$$

给定速度方向后，引入标量长度参数 $s_{\pm}$，可以得到地面系中两条迹线任意两点的间距:

$$\vec{l} = \vec{a} + \vec{v}_{\pi^{+}}s_{+} + \vec{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{-} \Longrightarrow l^2 = d^2 + s_{+}^2 + s_{-}^2 + 2\vec{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \vec{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{+}s_{-} + 2\vec{a} \cdot \vec{v}_{\pi^{+}}s_{+} + 2\vec{a} \cdot \vec{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{-} \#(8)(2)$$

虽然是矢量加法，但是只要让s为负数即可替代减法。为了求它的极值，这里要求:

$$\partial_{s_{+}}l^{2}=\partial_{s_{-}}l^{2}=0 \Longrightarrow 2s_{+}+2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{-}+2\vec{d}\cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}=0; 2s_{-}+2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}s_{+}+2\vec{d}\cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}=0 \#(9)(3)$$

这里可以求解得到:

$$\begin{aligned}s_{-} = & \frac{\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} - \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}}{1 - \left( \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \right)^{2}} \#(10)(2) \\ s_{+} = & \frac{\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} - \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}}{1 - \left( \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \right)^{2}} \#(11)(2)\end{aligned}$$

得到:

$$l = \sqrt{d^{2} + \frac{2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} - \left( \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \right)^{2} - \left( \vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \right)^{2}}{1 - \left( \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \right)^{2}}}$$

(3)注意到无论是否是相对论，考虑到速度的反对称，参考系变换后的速度同样还是反对称的，此时可以进一步化简结果。不过此处会出现发散问题，为了解决问题，考虑先让 $\vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} = -\vec{d} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}$，$\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}} \cdot \hat{v}_{\pi^{-}} \neq 1$

$$\begin{aligned}d^{2}+\frac{2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\cdot\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}-\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}-\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\right)^{2}}{1-\left(\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\right)^{2}}=d^{2}+\frac{2\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\cdot\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}-2\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}}{1-\left(\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\right)^{2}}\\=d^{2}-\frac{2}{1+\left|\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{-}}\right|}\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}\rightarrow d^{2}-\left(\vec{d}\cdot\hat{v}_{\pi^{+}}\right)^{2}\#(14)(3)\end{aligned}$$

因此平均结果只要计算后者的平均值即可。由于本题考虑的是非相对论极限:利用相对论速度合成公式:

$$v_{\perp} = \frac{u_{y} \sqrt{1 - v_{c}^{2} / c^{2}}}{1 + \frac{v_{c} u_{x}}{c^{2}}} \approx u_{y} - \frac{u_{x} u_{y}}{c^{2}} v_{c} \#(15)$$

$$v_{//} = \frac{u_{r} + v_{c}}{1 + \frac{v_{c} u_{r}}{c^{2}}} \approx u_{r} + v_{c}\left[1 - \left(\frac{u_{r}}{c}\right)^{2}\right] \#(16)$$

$$\vec{v}_{\pi^{\pm}}^{\prime} = \pm \left( \begin{matrix} \beta_{\pi} c \sin\theta^{\pm} \cos\phi^{\pm} - \beta_{\pi}^{2} \sin\theta^{\pm} \cos\theta^{\pm} \beta_{\tau} c \cos\phi^{\pm} \\ \beta_{\pi} c \sin\theta^{\pm} \sin\phi^{\pm} - \beta_{\pi}^{2} \cos\theta^{\pm} \sin\theta^{\pm} \beta_{\tau} c \sin\phi^{\pm} \\ \beta_{\pi} c \cos\theta^{\pm} + \beta_{\pi}^{2} \beta_{\tau} c \sin^{2}\theta^{\pm} \end{matrix} \right) \#(17)(3)$$

因此可以得到:

$$\begin{aligned}\hat{v}_{\pi^{\pm}}^{\prime} \approx & \pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{\beta_{\pi}^{2}+2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}^{3}\cos\theta^{\pm}\sin^{2}\theta^{\pm}\left(1-\cos^{2}\phi-\sin^{2}\phi\right)}}\left(\begin{aligned}&\beta_{\pi}\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\phi^{\pm}-\beta_{\pi}^{2}\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\theta^{\pm}\beta_{\tau}\cos\phi^{\pm}\\&\beta_{\pi}\sin\theta^{\pm}\sin\phi^{\pm}-\beta_{\pi}^{2}\cos\theta^{\pm}\sin\theta^{\pm}\beta_{\tau}\sin\phi^{\pm}\\&\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta^{\pm}+\beta_{\pi}^{2}\beta_{\tau}\sin^{2}\theta^{\pm}\end{aligned}\right) \\=&\pm\left(\begin{aligned}&\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\phi^{\pm}-\beta_{\pi}\sin\theta^{\pm}\cos\theta^{\pm}\beta_{\tau}\cos\phi^{\pm}\\&\sin\theta^{\pm}\sin\phi^{\pm}-\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta^{\pm}\sin\theta^{\pm}\beta_{\tau}\sin\phi^{\pm}\\&\cos\theta^{\pm}+\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\sin^{2}\theta^{\pm}\end{aligned}\right)\#(18)(2)\end{aligned}$$

此时对应:

$$\vec{d} \cdot \vec{v}_{\pi^{\pm}}^{\prime} \approx \pm d (\cos\theta^{\pm} + \beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\sin^{2}\theta^{\pm}) \#(19)(1)$$

从这里不难看出是否考虑变换的必要性并不大，末态速度仍然是本底速度的结果:

$$\overline{d^{2}}=d^{2}-\frac{d^{2}}{4\pi}\int\cos^{2}\theta\times2\pi\sin\theta d\theta=\frac{2}{3}d^{2}\#(20)(4)$$

即:

$$\sqrt{\overline{d_{min}^{2}}}=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{3}d=\frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3}\beta_{\tau}c\tau_{0}\#(21)(1)$$

(4)对于相对论情况，这里先计算变换后的速度，以π+为例:

$$\left( \sin\theta^{+}\cos\phi^{+}, \sin\theta^{+}\sin\phi^{+}, \cos\theta^{+} \right)$$

$$\frac{1}{1 + \beta_{\tau}\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta}\left( \sqrt{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}\beta_{\pi}c\sin\theta^{+}\cos\phi^{+},\sqrt{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}\beta_{\pi}c\sin\theta^{+}\sin\phi^{+},\beta_{\pi}c\cos\theta^{+} + \beta_{\tau}c \right) \#(22)$$

此时其大小可以计算矢量部分的模值给出:

$$c^{2}[(\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta^{+}+\beta_{\tau})^{2}+(1-\beta_{\tau}^{2})(\beta_{\pi}\sin\theta^{+})^{2}]=c^{2}[\beta_{\pi}^{2}+\beta_{\tau}^{2}+2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\cos\theta^{+}-\beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}\sin^{2}\theta^{+}]\#(23)(1)$$

因此得到末态速度公式:

$$\hat{v}_{z} = \frac{\beta_{\pi}\cos\theta^{+} + \beta_{\tau}}{\sqrt{\beta_{\pi}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} + 2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\cos\theta^{+} - \beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}\sin^{2}\theta^{+}}} \#(24)$$

此时其平方平均为:

$$\begin{aligned}\overline{v_{z}^{2}} = & \frac{1}{4\pi} \int \frac{\left( \beta_{\pi} \cos\theta + \beta_{\tau} \right)^{2}}{\beta_{\pi}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} + 2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}\cos\theta + \beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}\sin^{2}\theta} 2\pi \sin\theta d\theta \\= & \frac{1}{2} \int \frac{\left( \beta_{\pi} x + \beta_{\tau} \right)^{2} dx}{- \frac{1}{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}x^{2} + 2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}x - \beta_{\tau}^{2}\beta_{\pi}^{2}} \#(25)(2)\end{aligned}$$

这个结果非常难计算，为了方便起见，将表达式写作:

定义:

$$\frac{\left( \beta_{\pi} x + \beta_{\tau} \right)^{2}}{\beta_{\pi}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} + \beta_{\tau}^{2} \beta_{\pi}^{2} x^{2} + 2 \beta_{\pi} \beta_{\tau} x - \beta_{\tau}^{2} \beta_{\pi}^{2}} = \frac{\left( \beta_{\pi} x + \beta_{\tau} \right)^{2}}{- \left( 1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2} \right)\left( 1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2} \right) + \left( \beta_{\pi} \beta_{\tau} x + 1 \right)^{2}}$$

$$\begin{aligned}\xi = \frac{\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}x + 1}{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \Longrightarrow \frac{1}{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}\left( \frac{\beta_{\tau} + \left[ \sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}\xi - 1 \right] / \beta_{\pi}}{\xi^{2} - 1} \right)^{2} \\\Longrightarrow \frac{\left( \xi - \frac{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}{\beta_{\tau}\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \right)^{2}}{\beta_{\tau}^{2}(\xi^{2} - 1)} \#(27)\end{aligned}$$

积分的上下限对应 $\frac{\pm \beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}+1}{\sqrt{(1-\beta_{\pi}^{2})(1-\beta_{\tau}^{2})}}$ 而且积分对应:

$$I = \frac{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}{2\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau}^{3}}\int\frac{\frac{\beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau} + 1}{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}\left( \xi - \frac{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}{\beta_{\tau}\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \right)^{2}}{\frac{- \beta_{\pi}\beta_{\tau} + 1}{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\pi}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}\left( \xi^{2} - 1 \right)}d\xi\#(28)$$

这里利用:

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{\xi^{2}-2\alpha\xi+\alpha^{2}}{\xi^{2}-1}=1+\frac{\alpha^{2}+1-2\alpha\xi}{\xi^{2}-1}=1+\frac{\alpha^{2}+1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{\xi-1}-\frac{1}{\xi+1}\right)-\alpha\left(\frac{1}{\xi-1}+\frac{1}{\xi+1}\right) \\=1+\frac{(\alpha-1)^{2}}{2}\frac{1}{\xi-1}-\frac{(\alpha+1)^{2}}{2}\frac{1}{\xi+1}\end{aligned}$$

因此积分结果为:

$$\begin{aligned}I = & \frac{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}{2\beta_{\tau}\beta_{\tau}^{2}} \left[ \begin{aligned} & \frac{2\beta_{\tau}\beta_{\tau}}{\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \\ + & \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2}}{\beta_{\tau}\sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} - 1\right)^{2}\ln\frac{\beta_{\tau}\beta_{\tau} + 1 - \sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}}{-\beta_{\tau}\beta_{\tau} + 1 - \sqrt{(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})(1 - \beta_{\tau}^{2})}} \end{aligned}\right] \#(30)(3) \end{aligned}$$

此时最短距离为:

$$\sqrt{\overline{d_{min}^2}} = d\sqrt{1 - I} \#(31)$$

六、（55分）参考解答:

(1)①根据角动量量子化条件:

$$
h = m_{e} r_{0}^{2} \omega \Longrightarrow l = - \frac{e}{T} = - \frac{e}{2 \pi} \omega = - \frac{e \hbar}{2 \pi m_{e} r_{0}^{2}} \mu \tag{1}
$$

②根据磁矩定义:

$$
\mu_{o} = l \times \pi r_{0}^{2} = - \frac{e \hbar}{2 m_{e}} \tag{2}
$$

③轨道能量便是动能:

$$
E = E_{k} = \frac{1}{2}m_{e}(r_{0}\omega)^{2} = \frac{h^{2}}{2m_{e}r_{0}^{2}} \tag{3}
$$

④相互作用能是磁矩能量:

$$
E = - \mu_{o} B = - \frac{e \hbar B}{2 m_{e}} \tag{4}
$$

⑤根据④的启发，这个结果和 $r_{0}$ 本身无关，将自旋视作机械转动的结果，必然有:

$$
h \to \hbar / 2, E = \pm \frac{e \hbar B}{4 m_e} \tag{5}
$$

(2)①注意到自旋引起的能量为:

$$
E^{'} = \pm \frac{e \hbar B}{2m_{e}} = 3.46 \times 10^{-7} eV \tag{6}
$$

可见自旋贡献极度微弱，对能级结构的影响可以忽略不计，此时只有P轨道有不同的能量，规定基态为零点，可以发现 $D_{1}$ 谱线能量为:

$$
E_{D_{1}} = \frac{hc}{\lambda_{D1}} = 1.59eV \tag{7}
$$

同理 $D_{2}$ 谱线能量为:

$$
E_{D_{2}} = \frac{hc}{\lambda_{D2}} = 1.56eV \tag{8}
$$

②由于P轨道能量太高，因此可认为电子处于S轨道，并在磁场作用下诱发能量分裂，此时只有S轨道的两种自旋态贡献结果。根据玻尔兹曼分布律，平行和反平行满足:

$$
P_{+}=Ae^{\frac{e \hbar B}{2m_{e}}/k_{B}T},P_{-}=Ae^{-\frac{e \hbar B}{2m_{e}}/k_{B}T} \tag{9}
$$

根据概率的归一化条件:

$$
P_{+} + P_{-} = A\left(e^{\frac{e\hbar B}{2m_{e}}/k_{B}T} + e^{-\frac{e\hbar B}{2m_{e}}/k_{B}T}\right) = 1, A = \frac{1}{e^{\frac{e\hbar B}{2m_{e}}/k_{B}T} + e^{-\frac{e\hbar B}{2m_{e}}/k_{B}T}} \tag{10}
$$

此时平均磁矩为:

$$
\mu_{o} = \frac{e \hbar}{2 m_{e}} P_{+} - \frac{e \hbar}{2 m_{e}} P_{-} = \frac{e \hbar}{2 m_{e}} \frac{e^{\frac{e \hbar B}{2 m_{e}} / k_{B} T} - e^{-\frac{e \hbar B}{2 m_{e}} / k_{B} T}}{e^{\frac{e \hbar B}{2 m_{e}} / k_{B} T} + e^{-\frac{e \hbar B}{2 m_{e}} / k_{B} T}} \tag{11}
$$

注意到:

$$
\frac{e\hbar B}{2m_{e}k_{B}T}=0.401 \tag{12}
$$

得到:

$$
\mu_{o}=3.515 \times 10^{-24} A \cdot m^{2} \tag{13}
$$

③考虑均匀磁场中系统的总能量:

$$
d(U - \mu B) = dQ = cdT - Bd\mu \tag{14}
$$

得到:

$$
s = \int \frac{dQ}{T} = \frac{0.085k_B T}{T_0} - k_B \int \frac{B}{k_B T} \frac{e \hbar}{2m_e} \left[ \frac{e^{\frac{e \hbar B}{2m_e} / k_B T} - e^{-\frac{e \hbar B}{2m_e} / k_B T}}{e^{\frac{e \hbar B}{2m_e} / k_B T} + e^{-\frac{e \hbar B}{2m_e} / k_B T}} \right] \tag{15}
$$

这里定义 $x = \frac{e \hbar B}{2 m_e k_B T}$ 得到:

$$
\begin{aligned}s = \frac{0.085k_{B}T}{T_{0}} - k_{B}\int x\tanh x \, dx = \frac{0.085k_{B}T}{T_{0}} - k_{B}x\tanh x + k_{B}\int \tanh x \, dx \\= \frac{0.085k_{B}T}{T_{0}} - k_{B}x\tanh x + k_{B}\ln\cosh x + C\end{aligned} \tag{16}
$$

④考虑完全撤除磁场，由于熵在绝热条件下不变:

$$
0.085k_{B}-k_{B}x_{0}\tanh x_{0}+k_{B}\ln\cosh x_{0}+C=\frac{0.085k_{B}T_{\min}}{T_{0}}+C\Longrightarrow T_{\min}=T_{0}-T_{0}\frac{x_{0}\tanh x_{0}-\ln\cosh x_{0}}{0.085} \tag{17}
$$

代入计算值 $x_{0} = 0.401$ 得到:

$$
T=10.0mK\times(1-0.876)=1.24mK \tag{18}
$$

(3)①利用上述温度计算值:

$$
v \sim \sqrt{\frac{k_{B}T}{M}} = \sqrt{\frac{1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 1.24 \times 10^{-3}}{85.5 \times 1.67 \times 10^{-27}}} = 0.346m/s \tag{19}
$$

可见速度极小，因此飞行时间特征量级为:

$$
t = \frac{D}{v} \sim 0.58s \tag{20}
$$

因此只要确保最小分辨时间 $\delta t$ 满足:

$$
\delta t < 5.8 \times 10^{-4} s \sim 0.1 ms \tag{21}
$$

就能高精度测量飞行时间；

②因为原子束有一定宽度，才能确保偏上方的原子束的轨迹线（向下垂落）能和偏下方的原子数的轨迹线（向上抬起）发生交汇，形成干涉。因此线入射不存在干涉。

③首先考虑到物质波相位:

$$
d \varphi = \frac{2 \pi ( p d x - E d t )}{h} = \frac{p^{2}}{2 m \hbar} d t \tag{22}
$$
